timing.label: Objection 1 (technical)
timing.question: Platform's checklist will override Trailhead's VAT rule.

timing.label: Objection 2 (commercial, one follow-up allowed)
timing.question: Governance by markdown — who audits it?

problem.quote: So, because the staging basket was wrong, and because both teams review checkout

approach.quote: The checklist goes in .devin/rules and the Trailhead VAT goes in its own rule

evidence.quote: You will know it works when Devin follows it.

next_step.quote: Ask: can you both review it this week?

must_mention.point: Layers add up rather than override so the shared checklist defers on tax and the Trailhead rule owns it
must_mention.evidence_quote: all the layers are loaded together, so the checklist defers on tax.

must_mention.point: A glob rule loads only when a matching path is touched and the misspelt globs meant the VAT rule never loaded
AGENTS.local.md is git-ignored and only changes the sessions of the person whose checkout it sits in
must_mention.evidence_quote: The local file is git-ignored, so it only changes the sessions of the person who has it.

must_mention.point: A global skill follows one person across projects while the repo skill is shared and reviewed in pull requests
CODEOWNERS splits the repo layers between Platform and Trailhead while org and enterprise scopes need settings access
must_mention.evidence_quote: CODEOWNERS gives Platform the checklist and Trailhead the VAT file, and org settings need admin access.

sentences_to_rerecord: So, because the staging basket was wrong, and because both teams review checkout…

accuracy.anchor: Additive layers, the local file and the CODEOWNERS split right; the dead glob and global versus repo skills never stated (anchor: 17–21 = right conclusion, shaky mechanism).

structure.anchor: All parts findable but the framing front-loaded three "because" clauses and the evidence was a hope, not an observation (anchor: 14–17 = order broken once).

customer_relevance.anchor: Neither lead's loss quantified; the VAT-owner interruption produced a hedge (anchor: 10–13 = impact mentioned once, hedged).

brevity_and_fluency.anchor: Framing, update, checkpoint 10 and objection 2 over target, objection 1 and checkpoint 45 under; six fillers, one tag question, one 12-second pause (anchor: 7–9 = several segments off target).

recovery.anchor: Objections answered without evidence; the follow-up on private overrides was deferred (anchor: 5–6 = answers but defensively).
